summary: Atomic Heart entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Atomic Heart
entries.definitive_edition: Atomic Heart Ultimate Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC native resolution/settings with full DLC package

primary.version: Atomic Heart Ultimate Edition on Windows
primary.why: Windows, Windows Apps, Xbox One, Xbox Series, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 releases exist. Focus/Mundfish later released Blood on Crystal and the Ultimate Edition as the complete package with the Atomic Pass DLCs, so the archive route is the Windows Ultimate Edition for the highest settings/capture ceiling and complete story DLC access.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Ultimate Edition or the base Windows game plus Atomic Pass/all story DLC. Patch fully before capture, then verify graphics options and input behavior with community-style compatibility checks.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster. The important archive caveat is that the base game alone is no longer the complete story package after the four DLCs and Ultimate Edition.
